purpose: Public-only, no-key source candidates for VA IaT Location Reference Catalog population.

sources.name: DiscoverVA VA Locator Facility List
sources.expected_content: Raw facility list table with facility ID, name, city, state, latitude, longitude, classification, VISN, facility type, and website.

sources.name: VA.gov Directory / Locations Home
sources.expected_content: Directory metadata and facility count/status page. Useful as corroborating source, not primary bulk table.

sources.name: Data.gov Facilities & Leadership dataset metadata
sources.expected_content: Dataset metadata for VA facilities web service. Useful as provenance reference; service call may require a VA license key.

sources.name: Data.gov VA Facilities API metadata
sources.expected_content: Dataset metadata pointing to VA Lighthouse Facilities API. API key/token path is optional future lane only.
